scripts.build: bun run icons:build && bun run --cwd apps/vadivam-internal build && bun run --cwd apps/figma-plugin build && bun run --cwd apps/docs build
scripts.dev: bun run icons:build && bun run --cwd apps/docs dev
scripts.docs:build: bun run icons:build && bun run docs:build:built
scripts.docs:dev: bun run icons:build && bun run --cwd apps/docs dev
scripts.test:vadivam:built: bun --bun x publint packages/vadivam && bun test --preload ./tests/setup/happydom.ts tests/vadivam.client.test.mjs && bun test tests/vadivam.test.mjs tests/vadivam-static.test.mjs tests/vadivam-migrate.test.mjs
scripts.test:vadivam: bun run icons:build && bun run test:vadivam:built
scripts.test:react:unit:built: bun test --preload ./tests/setup/happydom.ts tests/vadivam-react/*.client.test.mjs && bun test tests/vadivam-react/*.ssr.test.mjs tests/vadivam-react/exports.test.mjs tests/vadivam-react/bundle.test.mjs
scripts.test:react:unit: bun run icons:build && bun run test:react:unit:built
scripts.test:vadivam-react:built: bun --bun x publint packages/vadivam-react && bun run test:react:unit:built
scripts.test:vadivam-react: bun run icons:build && bun run test:vadivam-react:built
scripts.test:react-native:unit: bun run icons:build && bun run test:react-native:unit:built
scripts.test:vadivam-react-native:built: bun --bun x publint packages/vadivam-react-native && bun run test:react-native:unit:built
scripts.test:vadivam-react-native: bun run icons:build && bun run test:vadivam-react-native:built
scripts.test:vadivam-mcp:built: bun --bun x publint packages/vadivam-mcp && bun test tests/vadivam-mcp/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:vadivam-mcp: bun run icons:build && bun run test:vadivam-mcp:built
scripts.test:integration: bun run icons:build && bun run test:integration:built
scripts.test:flutter:built: cd packages/vadivam-flutter && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test && flutter pub publish --dry-run
scripts.test:native:built: bun run test:flutter:built && bun run test:compose:built
scripts.test:native: bun run icons:build && bun run test:native:built
scripts.test:shadcn: bun run icons:build && bun run test:shadcn:built
scripts.test:seo:built: bun run docs:build:built && bun run --cwd apps/docs audit && bun test tests/seo.test.mjs tests/docs-search.test.mjs tests/release-notes.test.mjs tests/release-changes.test.mjs tests/wrangler-config.test.mjs tests/docs-404-twins.test.mjs tests/docs-fonts.test.mjs
scripts.test:seo: bun run icons:build && bun run test:seo:built
scripts.packages:check:built: bun run test:vadivam:built && bun run test:vadivam-react:built && bun run test:vadivam-react-native:built && bun run test:vadivam-mcp:built && bun run test:frameworks:unit && bun run packages:validate
scripts.packages:check: bun run icons:build && bun run packages:check:built
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun --cwd apps/docs wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:worker: bun run docs:build && bun --cwd apps/docs wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
